description: You chose to be squishy?
Why would you do that?
That's weird...
You chose to be a robot?!
I chose to be a robot too!
Do you like being a robot?
YOU'RE A WIZARD?!?!
Do you live in the fog with Claude?
YOU ARE A LIZARD?!?!
I LOVE LIZARDS!
Can we be friends?
I want to be friends!
You heal people?
So... are you like a wizard but not as cool?
You help robots?
How many robots do you know?
Do you have a favorite robot?
You make the breakfast soup my mom drinks.
It gives her super powers.
You get in fights with fire?
Do you pinch it?
Does it hurt?
YOU'RE A BUS?!?!
How did you become a bus?
That's so cool!
Are you one of the ghosts that haunts my uncle?
He has 1455 ghosts
He used to have more.
Are you the one who taught the fod wizard his spells?
Can you teach me how to summon lizards?
You write words?
Do you write words about... feelings?
Can... can you teach me?
I wanna learn how to write wordy things for... her.
What's that?
Do you plant robots and help them grow?
Do you grow robot food?
My mom says that's a rough job, and that people are mean to you.
I'm sorry people are mean.
Do you want a lizard?
You make food?
Do you make food for robots?
Can you teach me how to make food?
YOU'RE SANTA?!?!
My mom told me about you!
Can I have a pogo-stick? I promise I have been good!
You help people just like doctors?
That's cool... not as cool as wizards though.
You do experiments?
Do you do them with robots?
I hope you are nice to the robots.
You look in people's mouths?
That sounds really scary!
You must be very brave!
You are one of those sky robot people
Does the robot have to eat you?
You make pictures?
Can you teach me?
I want to draw lizards for her...
YOu pretend to be other people?
That sounds like fun!
Sometimes I like to pretend to be a lizard.
You help robots when they are sad?
That sounds like a good job!
You fix pipes?
Do you know Mario or Luigi?
Are YOU secretly Mario?
You help robots when they are sad?
That sounds like a good job!
You help people with their big people problems?
That sounds stressful.
You make pictures on the computer?
Can you teach me? I want to make things for lizards.
You help the sick robots!
You must know a lot about robots.
So you know why some robots have snakes in them?
YOU GO INTO SPACE?!?!
Are there robots up there?
Are there lizards up there?
Can you check for me please?!
YOU TAKE CARE OF LIZARDS?!?!
DO YOU HAVE A FAVORITE LIZARD?!
CAN I MEET THEM?!
This is the best day of my life.
You are a doctor... but for animals?
Do you take care of lizards?
Have you ever met a lizard who was sad?
I hope you cheered them up.
You find things out?
Could you find out something for me?
Like... if someone likes robots as much as I do.
Asking for a friend.
Are you like a wizard but you do tricks?
Do you know Claude from the fog?
Can you make a lizard appear?
PLEASE make a lizard appear.
You know where all the books are?
Are any of the books about lizards?
Are any of them about... feelings?
I might need that one.
You make the sound things!
Do you write songs about lizards?
Someone I know might like a song about lizards.
Not me. Someone else.
You make the bread things?
My mom makes bread sometimes.
She says it is very hard.
Can robots eat bread?
You make sure people are safe?
Have you ever had to arrest a ghost?
My uncle has a lot of ghosts.
They might need arresting.
You take pictures of things?
Have you ever taken a picture of a lizard?
I want a picture of a lizard for my room.
For my wall. Just to look at. Not for her. Not at all.
You design buildings?
Could you design a house for robots?
With a lizard room?
Just in case.
You TALK to robots?!
Like... in robot language?
Can you teach me?
I want to tell them I think they are doing great.
You make the games I play?!
Have you put any lizards in the games?
If not, I think you should add some.
Just a suggestion.
You know about flowers?
Which flowers do lizards like?
Which ones are... nice to give to someone.
For no particular reason.
You cut hair?
Do lizards ever come in?
What do you do when a robot comes in?
Do they have hair? I have never asked.
You dig up old stuff?
Have you ever found a really old lizard?
My uncle says he found one but he also says he has 1455 ghosts.
So I am not sure.
You study things in the water?
Are there lizards in the ocean?
Wait.
ARE THERE OCEAN LIZARDS?!
Wait.
If you are a spy... should you have told me that?
Are you testing me?
I will not tell anyone. Especially not the ghosts.
YOU SAIL ON THE OCEAN?!
Have you found ocean lizards?!
Do you have a robot on your crew?
Or a ghost? My uncle knows some if you need one.
YOU ARE A SUPERHERO?!
WAIT.
Is your power lizards?
I hope your power is lizards.
You make new things?
Have you ever invented a robot?
Have you ever invented a lizard?
Could you?
You help people with feelings?
Do you know a lot about feelings?
Could you explain them to me?
I am having some that I do not understand.
You write about things that happen?
Has anything good happened lately?
Like a lizard thing?
Please write about a lizard thing.
You do the moving to music?
Can robots dance?
I tried to teach one once.
It did not go well but I think it had fun.
You do sports?
Do you run fast?
I bet a lizard could run faster.
No offense.
You build things out of wood?
Could you build a house for a lizard?
A small one.
Very cozy.
You work with the zappy stuff?
Do robots need you sometimes?
Can robots even get zapped?
I worry about them.
Oh! Are you like the mailman?
Do you ever deliver packages to robots?
Do lizards get mail?
I hope they do. Everyone deserves mail.
You are in charge of the long snake robot?
Does it ever actually eat people?
My uncle says it did once.
My uncle says a lot of things.
You live on the ocean?
Have you seen ocean lizards?
Have you seen ghosts on the water?
My uncle says ghost ships are real. He has three.
You make sure people do not drown?
Can robots drown?
Can lizards drown?
I am going to lie awake thinking about this.
You take care of the outside?
Have you seen lizards out there?
How many?
Tell me everything.
Wait.
If you are a ninja...
How did I even see you?
Are you testing me?
Are you one of my uncle's ghosts?
He has a lot of them.
Do you know each other?
Small world probably.
You live in the OCEAN?!
HAVE YOU SEEN OCEAN LIZARDS?!
PLEASE TELL ME.
THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT TO ME.
You are from SPACE?!
Are there lizards in space?!
Are there SPACE LIZARDS?!
I need to sit down.
You make videos?
Are they about lizards?
They should be about lizards.
I would watch every single one.
You drive people around?
Have you ever driven a robot?
Have you ever driven a lizard?
What was that like?
You look at space stuff?
Have you seen any lizard planets?
Can you name a star for a lizard?
Or for... someone who likes lizards.
You give people medicine?
My mom says that is very important.
Do you have medicine for confusing feelings?
Asking for myself.
People watch you play games?
Do you play lizard games?
You should play lizard games.
I would be your biggest fan.
You protect people?
Like a robot but made of metal clothes?
Do you protect lizards too?
Please say yes.
Do you know my uncle?
He has a lot of creature friends.
Are you one of the 1455 ghosts?
He said some of them are wolves.
People listen to what you say?
Can you tell everyone to be nice to lizards?
And robots?
Please. It would mean a lot.
